description: The PB-53 RTO office is located in Malout, serving the Malout sub-division of the Sri Muktsar Sahib district in Punjab. It functions as a Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) office responsible for issuing driving licenses, vehicle registration certificates, and managing transport permits in this agricultural hub.
address: Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) Office, Tehsil Road, Malout, Punjab
